description: List the requests the running local server has answered, newest first: method, URL, status, content type, how long it took, and where the response came from (generated, upstream, replay or cache). Use it to show the user what their code actually sent, to confirm a call arrived, or to find the request to look at next. Pass `id` together with `service` for one request's full headers and body. Reads the server's own history API, so it needs no account and works entirely on localhost. To ask what is WRONG with the traffic rather than list it, call `diagnose_requests`.

failed_only.description: Only responses with status 400 or above.

id.description: One entry's id, from a previous listing. Needs `service` too. Returns full request and response headers and bodies.

path_contains.description: Only requests whose URL contains this substring.

service.description: Limit to one service. Omit to read every service the server has.

name: request_history
